words.enDefinition: an exorbitant or unlawful rate of interest

examples.en: The court struck down the loan as usury, charging forty percent a month.
examples.zh: 这笔月息百分之四十的放贷被法庭认定为「高利贷」而判无效。

examples.en: Medieval guilds punished usury far more harshly than petty smuggling.
examples.zh: 中世纪行会对「放高利贷」的惩罚远比小本走私严厉。

words.enDefinition: businessperson who transports goods abroad (for sale)

examples.en: The wool exporter books hull space three months ahead each spring.
examples.zh: 羊毛「出口商」每年春天提前三个月预订船位。

examples.en: As an exporter, she must declare every crate at the border.
examples.zh: 作为「出口商」，她必须在边境申报每一只货箱。

words.enDefinition: loss of goods through decay, damage, or waste, especially of inventory or raw materials

examples.en: Normal spoilage of two percent is built into the cheese budget.
examples.zh: 奶酪预算中计入了百分之二的正常「损耗」。

examples.en: The heatwave pushed spoilage in the cold store beyond all records.
examples.zh: 热浪使冷库中的「腐坏损失」超出以往所有记录。

words.enDefinition: an oil well with a strong natural flow so that pumping is not necessary

examples.en: The new well came in as a gusher, crude soaking the derrick floor.
examples.zh: 新井成了「自喷井」，原油漫过井架平台。

examples.en: Drillers capped the gusher before it flooded the valley road.
examples.zh: 钻井工人在「喷油井」淹没谷区道路之前把它封住了。

words.enDefinition: easily managed (controlled or taught or molded)

examples.en: The new apprentice is tractable, learning the press in a week.
examples.zh: 新学徒很「听话」，一周就学会了操作压机。

examples.en: A tractable crew accepted the new night rota without complaint.
examples.zh: 「好说话的」船员们毫无怨言地接受了新的夜班安排。

words.enDefinition: (law) the act of rescinding; the cancellation of a contract and the return of the parties to the positions they would have had if the contract had not been made

examples.en: The rescission of the charter left the ship idle in August.
examples.zh: 租船合同的「解除」让这条船八月闲置。

examples.en: Courts grant rescission when both sides can be restored to their starting positions.
examples.zh: 当双方都能恢复到签约前状态时，法院会准予「合同撤销」。

words.enDefinition: provide with computers

examples.en: The depot plans to computerize its stock records by October.
examples.zh: 货场计划在十月前把库存记录「电脑化」。

examples.en: They computerized the payroll years before the market office did.
examples.zh: 他们的工资系统「实现电脑化」比市场办公室早了好几年。

words.enDefinition: the quality of not being open or truthful; deceitful or hypocritical

examples.en: Customers quickly sensed the insincerity behind the shop's rehearsed apology.
examples.zh: 顾客很快察觉到店铺背台词式道歉背后的「不真诚」。

examples.en: Her insincerity at the supplier meeting cost us the discount.
examples.zh: 她在供应商会议上的「虚情假意」让我们丢了折扣。

words.enDefinition: an agent who handles something or someone

examples.en: Each cargo handler wears gloves rated for the frozen racks.
examples.zh: 每位「装卸工」都戴着适用于冷冻货架的手套。

examples.en: A calm handler keeps the stallion settled at the sales ring.
examples.zh: 沉着的「驯马师」让种马在拍卖场里保持安静。

words.enDefinition: fee paid for a nominally free service

examples.en: The guest lecturer received an honorarium rather than a salary.
examples.zh: 客座讲师收到的是一笔「酬金」，而非工资。

examples.en: An honorarium of fifty pounds thanked the retired inspector for his talk.
examples.zh: 五十英镑的「谢礼」答谢了退休稽查员的演讲。

words.enDefinition: person who pays money for something

examples.en: The payer must quote the invoice number on every transfer.
examples.zh: 「付款人」在每笔转账时都必须注明发票号。

examples.en: As the payer of last resort, the fund settles unpaid wages.
examples.zh: 作为最后的「付款方」，基金用于结清欠付工资。

words.enDefinition: (of paper money) not convertible into coin at the pleasure of the holder

examples.en: The irredeemable bonds pay interest forever but never return the principal.
examples.zh: 这种「不可赎回的」债券永远付息，但永不还本。

examples.en: Critics called the new irredeemable notes little better than confetti.
examples.zh: 批评者称新发行的「不可兑换」纸币与废纸相差无几。

words.enDefinition: a ship that trades along a coast

examples.en: The old coaster carries timber between the small river ports.
examples.zh: 这艘旧「沿海贸易船」在小河港之间运送木材。

examples.en: A coaster built in 1911 still plies the sheltered bays.
examples.zh: 一艘1911年建造的「沿岸商船」仍在平静的海湾间往返。

words.enDefinition: benefice to which no spiritual or pastoral duties are attached

examples.en: The archive post is a sinecure, an hour of sorting and long lunches.
examples.zh: 档案室这份差事是个「闲职」，整理一小时、午餐大半天。

examples.en: He quietly turned the honorary chairmanship into a well-paid sinecure.
examples.zh: 他把荣誉主席一职变成了薪酬丰厚的「挂名差事」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of cargo that can be held by a boat or ship or a freight car

examples.en: A shipload of Moroccan oranges arrived before the frost fair.
examples.zh: 一「整船」摩洛哥橙子在霜冻集市前到港。

examples.en: They ordered a shipload of slate for the courtyard roofs.
examples.zh: 他们订购了「一船」石板用于庭院屋顶。

words.enDefinition: of or limited to or involving supervision

examples.en: Her supervisory duties cover the weighbridge and the night gate.
examples.zh: 她的「监督」职责涵盖过磅桥和夜间大门。

examples.en: The board created a new supervisory committee for the ferry refit.
examples.zh: 董事会为轮渡翻新设立了一个新的「监督」委员会。

words.enDefinition: an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution

examples.en: A brightly printed flyer announced the pony club's open day.
examples.zh: 一张印制鲜艳的「传单」宣布了小马俱乐部的开放日。

examples.en: Volunteers handed a flyer to every car waiting at the level crossing.
examples.zh: 志愿者向每个在铁路道口等候的人发「宣传单」。

words.enDefinition: grant of financial aid as from a government to an educational institution

examples.en: A state subvention keeps the island ferry running through winter.
examples.zh: 州「补助金」让岛上轮渡整个冬天继续运营。

examples.en: The orchestra survives on a small municipal subvention each year.
examples.zh: 乐团每年靠一笔小额市政「补贴」维持。

words.enDefinition: be earlier in time; go back further

examples.en: The clerk noticed the receipt was antedated by three days.
examples.zh: 文员发现这张收据的日期被「倒填」了三天。

examples.en: Printed guides antedate the tower by at least a century.
examples.zh: 印行的这些指南比塔楼「早」了至少一个世纪。

words.enDefinition: servant employed to do a variety of jobs

examples.en: As general factotum, Marta opens the shop, fixes the boiler, and does the books.
examples.zh: 身为「杂务总管」，玛尔塔要开店、修锅炉、还要记账。

examples.en: The young factotum knows every key and every trader's moods.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的「打杂工」熟悉每把钥匙和每位商人的脾气。

words.enDefinition: political system governed by the wealthy people

examples.en: Shipping families formed a plutocracy that ran the port for decades.
examples.zh: 航运家族组成了一个把持港口数十年的「财阀统治集团」。

examples.en: Critics say the council has drifted into a plutocracy of mill owners.
examples.zh: 批评者说市政会已沦为磨坊主们的「财阀统治」。

words.enDefinition: a frame or hook on which clothes are hung

examples.en: Return each padded hanger to the rail after the fitting.
examples.zh: 试衣后请把每个软垫「衣架」放回挂杆。

examples.en: Wet coats bent every single wooden hanger in the cloakroom.
examples.zh: 湿大衣压弯了衣帽间里所有木质「衣架」。

words.enDefinition: file of memoranda or notices that remind of things to be done

examples.en: Her tickler file reminds the office of every licence renewal.
examples.zh: 她的「备忘」档案提醒办公室每一个执照续期。

examples.en: Check the tickler before you promise any firm delivery date.
examples.zh: 在承诺任何交期之前，先查一下「备忘录」。

words.enDefinition: an exhibition of cowboy skills

examples.en: The autumn rodeo draws stockmen and their families from three counties.
examples.zh: 秋季「牛仔竞技会」吸引了三个郡的牧场工人及其家人。

examples.en: Rodeo week doubles the takings of every saloon in town.
examples.zh: 「竞技表演周」让镇上每家酒馆的进账翻倍。

words.enDefinition: make a budget

examples.en: Careful budgeting kept the bakery open through two price spikes.
examples.zh: 精心的「预算编制」让面包店撑过了两次涨价风潮。

examples.en: Budgeting for the refit starts with the shipyard's written quote.
examples.zh: 翻新工程的「预算」工作从船厂的报价开始。

words.enDefinition: terseness and economy in writing and speaking achieved by expressing a great deal in just a few words

examples.en: The sheer conciseness of the tender impressed the harbour board.
examples.zh: 投标书的「简洁」给港务局留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The judges praised the manual's conciseness and its clear diagrams.
examples.zh: 评委称赞手册的「简明扼要」和清晰的图示。

words.enDefinition: an obligation to pay money to another party

examples.en: The firm's indebtedness tripled after work began on the second cold store.
examples.zh: 第二座冷库动工后，公司的「负债」翻了三倍。

examples.en: Rising indebtedness among the young smallholders worried the cooperative's treasurer.
examples.zh: 小农户「负债」不断上升，让合作社司库忧心。

words.zhGloss: 特大超市；大型超级市场
words.enDefinition: huge supermarket (usually built on the outskirts of a town)
acceptedZhAnswers: 特大超市；大型超级市场

examples.en: The new hypermarket on the ring road draws shoppers from three towns.
examples.zh: 环路旁新开的「大型超级市场」吸引了三个城镇的购物者。

examples.en: Small greengrocers struggle badly once a huge hypermarket opens nearby.
examples.zh: 附近一开「特大超市」，小蔬果店就很难熬。

words.enDefinition: someone whose business is advertising

examples.en: The advertiser booked every billboard along the coast road for June.
examples.zh: 「广告商」包下了沿海公路六月所有的广告牌。

examples.en: Local advertisers pay the ferry bulletin to reach daily travellers.
examples.zh: 本地「广告主」付费在轮渡简报上触达每日旅客。

words.enDefinition: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country

examples.en: Exportation of raw wool once funded the whole valley's trade.
examples.zh: 生羊毛「出口」曾养活整个山谷。

examples.en: New rules now restrict the exportation of unprocessed timber logs.
examples.zh: 新规限制了未加工原木的「出口」。

words.enDefinition: Same as Transshipment.

examples.en: Transhipment at Rotterdam adds four days to the delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 在鹿特丹「转运」会使交货期多出四天。

examples.en: The transhipment of grain from barge to silo runs overnight.
examples.zh: 粮食从驳船「转载」入筒仓的工作连夜进行。

words.enDefinition: time unit of approximately 30 days

examples.en: Rent is due on the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 租金在每「月」一号到期缴付。

examples.en: The refit slipped a month, pushing the launch into October.
examples.zh: 翻新工程拖了「一个月」，下水仪式推迟到十月。

words.enDefinition: unit of weight equivalent to 1000 kilograms

examples.en: The barge carries six hundred tonnes of gravel per run.
examples.zh: 驳船每趟运送六百「吨」砂砾。

examples.en: Prices rose ten pounds per tonne after the quay closed.
examples.zh: 码头关闭后，价格每「吨」上涨十英镑。

words.enDefinition: the number 1,000,000,000,000 (10¹²) in the short scale used in modern English

examples.en: The infrastructure plan promises a trillion pounds of port spending.
examples.zh: 基础设施计划承诺投入「万亿」英镑的港口开支。

examples.en: Trade in the bloc tops a trillion dollars a year.
examples.zh: 该集团的年贸易额超过「万亿」美元。

words.enDefinition: particular instance of selling

examples.en: The sale of the old maltings funded the new cold store.
examples.zh: 老麦芽厂的「出售」为新建冷库提供了资金。

examples.en: Horse sales fill every inn in the market town each autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，马匹「交易」让集镇上每家客栈都住满。

words.enDefinition: period of time containing 365 (or 366) days

examples.en: The lease runs for a year from the first of May.
examples.zh: 租约自五月一日起为期一「年」。

examples.en: Sales doubled year on year after the new bypass opened.
examples.zh: 绕城公路开通后，销量「年」年翻倍。

words.enDefinition: having little money or means; of low quality

examples.en: Poor families relied on the co-op's cheap weekly flour ration.
examples.zh: 「贫穷的」家庭靠合作社的廉价面粉配给度日。

examples.en: The poor soil on the headland grows only fodder oats.
examples.zh: 海角上「贫瘠的」土壤只长饲料燕麦。

words.enDefinition: lacking strength; (of a market) soft or declining

examples.en: Demand for slate stayed weak through the whole building season.
examples.zh: 整个建筑季，石板需求都很「疲软」。

examples.en: The pound closed the week weak against a rising euro.
examples.zh: 英镑本周收「弱」，对面上扬的欧元。

words.enDefinition: the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food

examples.en: The butcher hangs the meat for three weeks before cutting.
examples.zh: 肉铺把「肉」悬挂三周后才切割。

examples.en: Meat shipments need the chiller running from dock to market.
examples.zh: 「肉类」运输需要冷藏箱从码头到市场全程运转。

words.enDefinition: fractional monetary unit of several countries

examples.en: The price per litre rose by just a cent or two.
examples.zh: 每升价格只涨了一两「分」钱。

examples.en: Shops round the bill total to the nearest five cents.
examples.zh: 商店把账单总额凑整到最接近的五「分」。

words.enDefinition: Through; by means of; through the agency of; by; for; for

examples.en: Freight runs at twelve pounds per crate during the winter months.
examples.zh: 冬季运费为「每」箱十二英镑。

examples.en: Rooms are priced per night, breakfast included in the rate.
examples.zh: 客房按「每」晚计价，含早餐。

words.enDefinition: in the middle of; surrounded by

examples.en: The stallholders kept pricing amid the noise of the morning rush.
examples.zh: 摊主们在早市喧嚣「之中」坚持报价。

examples.en: Shares steadied amid talk of a takeover bid from the north.
examples.zh: 在北部收购意向传闻「之中」，股价企稳。

words.enDefinition: skill in dealing with people or difficult situations without causing offence

examples.en: With great tact, the manager deferred the rent rise until spring.
examples.zh: 经理十分「得体」地把涨租推迟到春天。

examples.en: Telling a loyal supplier his prices run high takes real tact.
examples.zh: 要告诉老供应商他的报价偏高，很需要「分寸」。

words.enDefinition: written proposal or reminder

examples.en: Send a short memo to every stallholder about the winter hours.
examples.zh: 给每位摊主发一份关于冬季营业时间的简短「备忘录」。

examples.en: The memo on fuel allowances reached the drivers too late.
examples.zh: 关于燃油补贴的「内部通知」送抵司机时已经太迟。

words.enDefinition: (law) a legal document issued by a court or judicial officer

examples.en: The bailiff served the writ an hour before the market opened.
examples.zh: 集市开市前一小时，执法官送达了「法院令状」。

examples.en: A writ stopped the demolition of the old toll house.
examples.zh: 一纸「法院命令」叫停了老收费站住宅的拆除。

words.enDefinition: a very strong wind, typically force 7–10 on the Beaufort scale

examples.en: A sudden gale tore the tarpaulins off three stalls overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜「大风」掀翻了三个摊位的防水布。

examples.en: The shipping forecast warns of gale-force winds along the strait.
examples.zh: 航运预报警告海峡沿岸将有「大风」天气。

words.enDefinition: wharf usually built parallel to the shoreline

examples.en: Crates were stacked along the quay before the tide turned.
examples.zh: 涨潮之前，货箱堆放在「码头」边。

examples.en: The fishing boats tie up at the stone quay each evening.
examples.zh: 渔船每晚都停靠在石砌「顺岸码头」。

words.enDefinition: former measure of the United States economy; the total market value of goods and services produced by all citizens and capital during a given period (usually 1 yr)

examples.en: The ministry linked the harbour toll cut to a rise in GNP.
examples.zh: 主管部门把削减港口税费与「国民生产总值」上升挂钩。

examples.en: GNP figures for the island include the ferry company's mainland earnings.
examples.zh: 岛屿的「国民生产总值」数字包含轮渡公司在大陆的收入。

words.enDefinition: that which is deserved or owed

examples.en: Traders pay their guild dues before the spring fair opens.
examples.zh: 商贩在春季集市开市前缴纳「会费」。

examples.en: The treasurer collects harbour dues from every one of the visiting boats.
examples.zh: 司库向每艘来访船只收取港口「规费」。

words.enDefinition: federal law enforcement agency that is the principal investigative arm of the Department of Justice

examples.en: The FBI traced the counterfeit bills to a print shop in Leeds.
examples.zh: 「美国联邦调查局」把假钞来源追查到利兹的一家印刷厂。

examples.en: An FBI liaison officer briefed the port police about the smugglers.
examples.zh: 一名「联邦调查局」联络官向港警通报了走私者情况。

words.enDefinition: United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds

examples.en: The empty lorry weighs almost a full ton before loading.
examples.zh: 空载的卡车就有差不多一「吨」重。

examples.en: Freight rates are quoted per ton for the building sand.
examples.zh: 建筑用砂的运费按「吨」报价。

words.enDefinition: mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined

examples.en: Trains carry iron ore from the mine to the smelter nightly.
examples.zh: 列车每晚把铁「矿石」从矿区运往冶炼厂。

examples.en: The assay confirmed rich iron ore in the second shaft.
examples.zh: 化验证实二号矿井里有品位很高的「矿石」。

words.enDefinition: abbreviation of versus, used to show opposition or comparison between two sides or options

examples.en: The programme lists Cider vs Perry as the final contest.
examples.zh: 节目单把苹果酒「对阵」梨酒列为决赛项目。

examples.en: Buyers weighed quality vs price before signing the winter contract.
examples.zh: 买家在「对比」质量与价格后才签冬季合同。

words.enDefinition: a card issued by a bank that lets the holder buy now and pay later

examples.en: The stall finally takes credit card payments through the little reader.
examples.zh: 摊位终于能通过小读卡器收「信用卡」付款了。

examples.en: She cleared the supplier bill on her company credit card.
examples.zh: 她用公司的「信用卡」付清了供应商账单。

words.zhGloss: 在船（机、车）上；已装船；赞成
words.enDefinition: in agreement with a plan, or physically on a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
acceptedZhAnswers: 在船（机、车）上；已装船；赞成

examples.en: The manifest confirms the crates are on board the evening ferry.
examples.zh: 舱单确认货箱已「装上」晚班轮渡。

examples.en: Once the treasurer explained the fees, the committee was on board.
examples.zh: 司库解释完费用后，委员会全体「表示赞成」。

words.enDefinition: before something happens; ahead of the required time

examples.en: Book the stall pitch in advance; the August fair fills fast.
examples.zh: 摊位要「提前」预订，八月集市很快订满。

examples.en: Payment in advance secures the last chilled van of the season.
examples.zh: 「预付」全款才能锁定本季最后一辆冷藏车。

words.enDefinition: intense competition in which sellers repeatedly cut prices to win customers
acceptedZhAnswers: 价格战-价格上的商业竞争

examples.en: A price war broke out between the two petrol stations.
examples.zh: 两家加油站之间爆发了「价格战」。

examples.en: The milk price war left the smallest dairies with no margin.
examples.zh: 牛奶「价格战」让最小的乳品厂毫无利润。

words.enDefinition: the cost of reproducing or replacing an asset or product

examples.en: Insurers value the greenhouse at its reproduction cost, not market price.
examples.zh: 保险公司按「再生产成本」而非市价给温室估价。

examples.en: Reproduction cost rose once the imported glass panels doubled in price.
examples.zh: 进口玻璃板价格翻倍后，「重置成本」随之上涨。

words.enDefinition: fees paid to salespeople based on the sales they generate

examples.en: Sales commissions are paid monthly on fully collected orders only.
examples.zh: 「销售佣金」按月发放，只计已回款的订单。

examples.en: The new plan caps sales commissions at eight percent of invoice value.
examples.zh: 新方案把「销售佣金」上限设为发票金额的百分之八。

words.enDefinition: profit arising from regular business operations

examples.en: The auditors separated earned profit from one-off land sale gains.
examples.zh: 审计师把「经营利润」与一次性的卖地收益区分开来。

examples.en: Earned profit fell while speculation returns climbed in the accounts.
examples.zh: 账目中「经营利润」下降，投机收益却在攀升。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from subsidiary

examples.en: Subsidiary revenue from the car park now covers the office rent.
examples.zh: 停车场的「附属收入」如今能抵付办公室租金。

examples.en: The group now reports subsidiary revenue separately from core trade.
examples.zh: 集团把「子公司营业收入」与核心业务分列报告。

words.enDefinition: gains, yields, or goods sent back related to trade

examples.en: Trade returns of damaged tiles rose sharply after the frost.
examples.zh: 霜冻之后，瓷砖的「退货」明显增加。

examples.en: The monthly trade returns feed the head buyer's seasonal forecast.
examples.zh: 每月的「贸易回报」数据用于采购员的季节预测。

words.enDefinition: official rules governing trade

examples.en: New trade regulations require origin labels on every woven basket.
examples.zh: 新「贸易法规」要求每只编织篮标注原产地。

examples.en: Traders studied the new trade regulations before the tariff change.
examples.zh: 关税调整前，商贩们研读了新的「贸易规章」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged to trade buyers, usually below retail

examples.en: Dealers buy stock at trade price and mark it up for retail.
examples.zh: 经销商按「批发价」进货，再加价零售。

examples.en: Show your trade card to get the trade price on fittings.
examples.zh: 出示同业卡，五金件即可享受「同行价」。

words.enDefinition: an agency that promotes or handles trade

examples.en: The county granted the trade agency rights over the wool market.
examples.zh: 郡里把羊毛市场的「商业代理权」授予了该机构。

examples.en: Their trade agency covers both the grain and seed contracts.
examples.zh: 他们的「贸易代理」业务涵盖谷物和种子两类合同。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from list price given to trade buyers

examples.en: Join the guild to claim the trade discount on harness leather.
examples.zh: 加入行会即可享受马具皮革的「商业折扣」。

examples.en: The trade discount disappeared once the shop began selling to walk-ins.
examples.zh: 店铺开始接待散客后，「同行折扣」就取消了。

words.enDefinition: manufacture carried out on a commercial scale

examples.en: Commercial manufacture of the press began once the patent cleared.
examples.zh: 专利获批后，压机的「商业化制造」随即启动。

examples.en: The village moved from craft production to commercial manufacture in a decade.
examples.zh: 十年间，村里的手工作坊转向了「商业性制造」。

words.enDefinition: costs arising from commercial activity

examples.en: Commercial cost per unit falls once the second kiln runs.
examples.zh: 第二座窑启用后，单件「商业成本」下降。

examples.en: They folded advertising into the commercial cost column this year.
examples.zh: 今年他们把广告费并入「商业费用」栏。

words.enDefinition: the cost of reproducing or replacing an asset or product

examples.en: The valuer priced the old looms at their cost of reproduction.
examples.zh: 估价师按「重置成本」为这些旧织机定价。

examples.en: Cost of reproduction has climbed since the imported parts vanished.
examples.zh: 进口零件绝迹后，「再生产成本」一路攀升。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for contract

examples.en: Contract costing tracks every hour the crane spends on the jetty.
examples.zh: 「合同成本核算」记录起重机在突堤上花费的每个工时。

examples.en: Under contract costing, each road job carries its own ledger.
examples.zh: 采用「合同成本法」后，每项道路工程都有独立账册。

words.enDefinition: an agent who sells a manufacturer’s goods in export markets

examples.en: The manufacturer's export agent books the tea shipment through Liverpool.
examples.zh: 「厂家出口代理人」通过利物浦预订茶叶船运。

examples.en: Appoint a manufacturer's export agent before printing the foreign catalogue.
examples.zh: 印制外文目录之前，先委任一名「厂商出口代理」。

words.zhGloss: 未交货订单的制造费用
words.enDefinition: standing orders used to allocate or control manufacturing expenses
acceptedZhAnswers: 未交货订单的制造费用

examples.en: The works manual lists the manufacturing expenses standing orders for each line.
examples.zh: 工厂手册逐条列示各生产线的「制造费用长期通知单」。

examples.en: Auditors checked the manufacturing expenses standing orders against the variances.
examples.zh: 审计员将「制造费用标准通知单」与差异逐项核对。

collocations: issue the manufacturing expenses standing orders
review the manufacturing expenses standing orders

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for manufacturing

examples.en: Heating costs drove manufacturing expenses up eleven percent this winter.
examples.zh: 今年冬天取暖使「制造费用」上升了百分之十一。

examples.en: Review the manufacturing expenses monthly to catch small leaks early.
examples.zh: 每月核查「生产费用」，及早发现小漏洞。

words.enDefinition: a business enterprise engaged in manufacturing

examples.en: The grant supports any manufacturing enterprise employing over twenty people.
examples.zh: 该补助面向雇工超过二十人的「制造企业」。

examples.en: Their manufacturing enterprise grew from two lathes in a shed.
examples.zh: 他们的「制造企业」是从棚屋里两台车床起家的。

words.enDefinition: an order related to manufacturing

examples.en: The manufacturing order for the autumn tins releases next Monday.
examples.zh: 秋季罐头的「制造通知单」下周一发放。

examples.en: Shop floor teams pick material only against a signed manufacturing order.
examples.zh: 车间只凭签署的「生产订单」领料。

words.enDefinition: production organised to match market demand

examples.en: Market-oriented production replaced the old habit of making first and asking later.
examples.zh: 「以销定产」取代了先造后问的老习惯。

examples.en: The co-op switched to market-oriented production after two glut seasons.
examples.zh: 经历两个滞销季后，合作社转向「市场导向生产」。

words.enDefinition: management control over a sales team

examples.en: The sales director tightened control of sales force territories last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，销售总监收紧了「销售队伍」的辖区管理。

examples.en: Good control of sales force hours cut overtime by a third.
examples.zh: 管好「销售人员」的工时让加班费少了三分之一。

words.enDefinition: a system for production management

examples.en: The new production management system flags any batch missing a test.
examples.zh: 新的「生产管理系统」会标记任何缺少检测的批次。

examples.en: They credit the production management system for fewer late orders.
examples.zh: 他们把迟到订单减少归功于「生产管理系统」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting production order cost

examples.en: The production order cost sheet tracks wool, dye, and machine hours.
examples.zh: 「生产订单成本单」逐项记录羊毛、染料和机时。

examples.en: Attach the production order cost sheet before invoicing the co-op.
examples.zh: 给合作社开票前，先附上「生产成本单」。

words.enDefinition: the management and organisation of business operations

examples.en: She studied business administration between shifts at the family bakery.
examples.zh: 她在家族面包店的轮班间隙修读「企业管理」。

examples.en: Good business administration keeps the ledgers and the licence current.
examples.zh: 良好的「企业管理」让账册和执照都保持有效。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred before production begins

examples.en: Pre-production expenditures covered the moulds long before the first order.
examples.zh: 「试生产开支」在首份订单之前就投入了模具。

examples.en: They wrote the pre-production expenditures off over three whole seasons.
examples.zh: 「投产前支出」分三个整季度摊销完毕。

words.enDefinition: management of business

examples.en: Her diploma in business management helped reorder the cold chain.
examples.zh: 「企业管理」文凭帮她理顺了冷链流程。

examples.en: Poor business management, not the frost, sank the packing shed.
examples.zh: 压垮包装棚的是糟糕的「经营管理」，而非霜冻。

words.enDefinition: the cost of handling goods or materials

examples.en: Palletising cut the handling cost of every single mixed order.
examples.zh: 托盘化降低了每张混载订单的「搬运成本」。

examples.en: The handling cost rises whenever the crates change hands twice.
examples.zh: 货箱每多倒手一次，「装卸成本」就会上升。

words.enDefinition: a graph showing how costs, volume, and profit relate

examples.en: The cost-volume-profit graph shows exactly where the creamery breaks even.
examples.zh: 「成本数量利润图」清楚标出奶油厂的保本点。

examples.en: Trainees draw a cost-volume-profit graph before quoting any new contract.
examples.zh: 学员在给任何合同报价前都要先画「本量利图」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for other expenses

examples.en: The other expenses budget covers licences, cleaning, and small repairs.
examples.zh: 「其他费用预算」涵盖牌照、清洁和小型维修。

examples.en: They trimmed the other expenses budget to fund the new sign.
examples.zh: 他们压缩「其他费用预算」，凑钱做了新招牌。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage operational cost

examples.en: Operational cost control here begins with metering every cold room.
examples.zh: 这里的「运营成本管控」从给每间冷库装表开始。

examples.en: Their operational cost control saved the depot a fuel run.
examples.zh: 严格的「经营成本管理」为货场省下一趟燃油开销。

words.enDefinition: the cost of running an operation

examples.en: Operation cost per delivery fell once the routes were zoned.
examples.zh: 线路分区后，单次配送的「营业成本」下降。

examples.en: Fuel dominates the operation cost of the whole ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 燃油占轮渡「运营成本」的大头。

words.zhGloss: 营业成本制度；经营成本系统
words.enDefinition: a costing system that records and analyses operating (business) costs
acceptedZhAnswers: 营业成本制度；经营成本系统

examples.en: The operation cost system charges each van its own fuel.
examples.zh: 「营业成本制度」让每辆货车单独核算油耗。

examples.en: Auditors praised the operation cost system for its clear reports.
examples.zh: 审计员称赞「经营成本系统」报表清晰。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for capacity

examples.en: Capacity costing shows the true weekly price of idle ovens.
examples.zh: 「生产能量成本计算」揭示闲置烤炉的真实代价。

examples.en: Under capacity costing, half-empty sailings still carry full crew cost.
examples.zh: 按「产能成本法」，半空的航次也要摊全额船员成本。

words.enDefinition: payable when shipping or trade documents are presented

examples.en: The full amount is payable against documents at the presenting bank.
examples.zh: 全款须在代收银行「凭单付款」。

examples.en: Buyers accept payable against documents terms once the cargo is inspected.
examples.zh: 货物查验后，买方接受「凭单付款」条款。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit that requires stipulated commercial/shipping documents before payment

examples.en: The seller insisted on a commercial documentary letter of credit for the first order.
examples.zh: 首单生意，卖方坚持用「商业跟单信用证」结算。

examples.en: Banks charge more to open a commercial documentary letter of credit.
examples.zh: 开立「商业跟单信用证」银行收费更高。

collocations: arrange the commercial documentary letter of credit
monitor the commercial documentary letter of credit
repay the commercial documentary letter of credit

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to cash on delivery

examples.en: Cash on delivery sales suit the small town rounds perfectly.
examples.zh: 「货到付款销售」非常适合小镇配送路线。

examples.en: The catalogue added cash on delivery sales for new customers.
examples.zh: 目录购物为新顾客开通了「货到付款」销售。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for shipping

examples.en: Shipping expenses doubled once the new canal tolls took effect.
examples.zh: 新运河通行费生效后，「运输费用」翻倍。

examples.en: Book the shipping expenses against the export order, not overhead.
examples.zh: 「装运费用」应记入出口订单，而非管理费用。

words.enDefinition: the total cost of goods including delivery to the buyer

examples.en: Compare the delivered cost, not just the factory gate price.
examples.zh: 要比较「到货成本」，别只看出厂价。

examples.en: Delivered cost includes the ferry crossing and the cold chain fee.
examples.zh: 「交货成本」包含轮渡过渡费和冷链费。

words.enDefinition: orders related to standing

examples.en: The bakery keeps standing orders with six hotels for morning bread.
examples.zh: 面包店与六家酒店签有晨间面包的「固定订单」。

examples.en: Standing orders smoothed the dairy's cash flow all through winter.
examples.zh: 「长期订单」让乳品厂冬天的现金流平稳。

words.enDefinition: a marketplace where firm trading activity takes place

examples.en: The firm trading market for brass fittings held its prices all spring.
examples.zh: 整个春天，铜配件「稳定的贸易市场」价格坚挺。

examples.en: Buyers call it a firm trading market when quotes stop falling.
examples.zh: 报价止跌时，买家便称之为「坚挺的贸易市场」。

collocations: clear goods through the firm trading market

words.enDefinition: the initial acquisition or manufacturing cost before later charges

examples.en: First cost covers the mould, not the paint or packing.
examples.zh: 「原始成本」只含模具，不含喷漆和包装。

examples.en: Sellers quoting first cost alone often surprise their buyers later.
examples.zh: 只报「原始成本」的卖家常让买家后续吃惊。

words.enDefinition: a cost that rises in steps as activity increases

examples.en: Supervision is a stepped cost, jumping at every fifth worker.
examples.zh: 监督费是「阶梯式成本」，每增五名工人就跳一档。

examples.en: Plot the stepped cost curve before promising the fourth van.
examples.zh: 答应添置第四辆货车前，先画好「阶梯成本」曲线。

words.enDefinition: an order document or instruction for special production

examples.en: A single special production order covers the commemorative tankards only.
examples.zh: 这份「特种生产订单」只涵盖纪念啤酒杯。

examples.en: The workshop charges a premium on any special production order.
examples.zh: 接任何「特制订单」，工坊都会加收溢价。

words.enDefinition: a system for decentralized profit control

examples.en: Their decentralized profit control system lets each branch sign off its own margins.
examples.zh: 「分权式利润管理系统」让各分店自行核签毛利。

examples.en: Under the decentralized profit control system, depot managers answer for margins.
examples.zh: 在「分权利润管理制」下，货场经理要对利润负责。

collocations: apply the decentralized profit control system
adopt the decentralized profit control system
document the decentralized profit control system

words.enDefinition: informal label for a speculative or loosely regulated securities market (historical U.S. “blue-sky” context)

examples.en: Lawmakers of the era attacked the blue-sky market for unbacked shares.
examples.zh: 当年立法者抨击「蓝天市场」兜售无担保股票。

examples.en: Grandfather's old ledgers mention a blue-sky market permit from 1923.
examples.zh: 祖父的旧账本里夹着一张1923年的「蓝天市场」执照。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for selling expense

examples.en: The selling expense budget funds all the autumn tasting stalls.
examples.zh: 「销售费用预算」为秋季试吃摊位提供经费。

examples.en: Trim the selling expense budget before touching the driver wages.
examples.zh: 动司机工资之前，先压缩「销售费用预算」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for selling cost

examples.en: Her selling cost budget separates ferry ads from local flyers.
examples.zh: 她的「销售成本预算」把轮渡广告与本地传单分列。

examples.en: The selling cost budget overran after the second catalogue print.
examples.zh: 第二次印目录后，「销售成本预算」超支了。

words.enDefinition: the cost of service department

examples.en: Service department cost is shared across the three production lines.
examples.zh: 「服务部门成本」由三条生产线分摊。

examples.en: Metering water cut the service department cost of the canteen.
examples.zh: 水表改造降低了食堂的「服务部门成本」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of providing a service

examples.en: The service cost of each lease includes two free visits.
examples.zh: 每份租约的「服务成本」含两次免费上门。

examples.en: Rising service cost pushed the repair contract up a tier.
examples.zh: 「服务成本」上涨使维修合同上调了一档。

words.enDefinition: income earned from selling goods or services

examples.en: Sales revenues from the holiday hampers fund the January stock.
examples.zh: 节日礼篮的「销售收入」为一月备货提供资金。

examples.en: Report the sales revenues net of the ferry ticket refunds.
examples.zh: 「销售收入」按扣除轮渡退款后的净额上报。

words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of benefit-cost

examples.en: A careful benefit-cost analysis sank the second weighbridge proposal last year.
examples.zh: 一项细致的「成本效益分析」否决了第二座过磅桥的方案。

examples.en: Run a benefit-cost analysis before leasing the fourth cold van.
examples.zh: 租第四辆冷藏车之前，先做「成本收益分析」。

words.enDefinition: to pay or be responsible for a cost

examples.en: The shipper will bear the cost of the return empties.
examples.zh: 回程空箱的费用由发货方「承担」。

examples.en: Who will bear the cost of the extra border inspection?
examples.zh: 额外检验的费用由谁来「承担」？

words.enDefinition: amounts received from customers before goods or services are delivered

examples.en: Advances from customers had covered the wool before shearing season.
examples.zh: 剪毛季之前，「客户预付款」就覆盖了羊毛采购。

examples.en: Book the advances from customers as a liability, not income.
examples.zh: 「客户预付款」应记为负债，而非收入。

words.enDefinition: a deposit required in advance, often under an import-deposit scheme

examples.en: The advanced deposit scheme tied up the importer's cash for months.
examples.zh: 「进口押金」制度占用了进口商数月的现金。

examples.en: Pay the advanced deposit at the customs counter, not the gate.
examples.zh: 「预付押金」在海关柜台缴纳，别在闸口交。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for administrative

examples.en: The administrative budget covers the office rent and the auditors.
examples.zh: 「行政预算」涵盖办公室租金和审计费用。

examples.en: Councilors trimmed the administrative budget to protect the ferry subsidy.
examples.zh: 议员们压缩「行政预算」，保住了轮渡补贴。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for administration

examples.en: Her administration budget lists every subscription the office renews yearly.
examples.zh: 她的「行政预算」列明办公室每年续订的每一项服务。

examples.en: The administration budget froze all hiring for the second half.
examples.zh: 「管理费用预算」冻结了下半年的招聘。

words.enDefinition: the amount of revenue expected or budgeted for a future period

examples.en: Estimated revenue for the fair assumes dry skies all weekend.
examples.zh: 集市的「预计收入」假定整个周末天晴。

examples.en: Treasury estimated revenue fell well short when the ferry closed.
examples.zh: 轮渡停航后，财政「预算收入」未达预期。

words.enDefinition: a receiver appointed to protect equity interests in a distressed firm

examples.en: The court appointed an equity receiver to shield the minority shareholders.
examples.zh: 法院指定一名「权益清算人」保护少数股东。

examples.en: As equity receiver, she sold the boats at a fair reserve.
examples.zh: 作为「权益接管人」，她按合理保留价出售了船只。

words.zhGloss: 股东权益与资产的比率
words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates equity to assets
acceptedZhAnswers: 股东权益与资产的比率

examples.en: The bank liked our equity to assets ratio at sixty percent.
examples.zh: 银行看中我们百分之六十的「股东权益与资产比率」。

examples.en: A rising equity to assets ratio eased the renewal terms.
examples.zh: 「权益对资产比率」上升让续贷条件放宽。

collocations: calculate the equity to assets ratio
compare the equity to assets ratio
interpret the equity to assets ratio

words.enDefinition: management of drifting

examples.en: Drifting management let the warehouse overflow for three straight quarters.
examples.zh: 「放任自流的管理」让仓库连续三个季度爆满。

examples.en: Under drifting management, nobody chased up the overdue export papers.
examples.zh: 在「随波逐流的管理」下，没人催办逾期的出口单证。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to working

examples.en: The driller holds a working interest in the second well.
examples.zh: 钻井方在二号井持有「经营权益」。

examples.en: Our working interest pays out after the royalty is deducted.
examples.zh: 我们的「经营权益」分成在扣除矿区使用费后支付。

words.enDefinition: the cost of acquiring an asset or business

examples.en: The acquisition cost included two years of unpaid harbour dues.
examples.zh: 「取得成本」包含两年未缴的港口规费。

examples.en: Depreciation starts from the acquisition cost, not the asking price.
examples.zh: 折旧以「购置成本」为基础，而非要价。

words.zhGloss: 可变间接费(制造费用)预算差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual variable overhead budget
acceptedZhAnswers: 可变间接费(制造费用)预算差异

examples.en: The variable overhead budget variance widened after the fuel spike.
examples.zh: 燃油涨价后，「可变制造费用预算差异」扩大。

examples.en: Explain the variable overhead budget variance line at the review.
examples.zh: 在复盘会上要说明「变动间接费用预算差异」这一行。

words.enDefinition: a tax credit based on earned income

examples.en: The earned income credit lifted the pickers' net pay each spring.
examples.zh: 「劳动所得税收抵免」每年春天增加采摘工的实得工资。

examples.en: Claim the earned income credit when you file the market returns.
examples.zh: 申报集市税务时记得申请「劳动所得抵免」。

words.enDefinition: cost measured in economic terms, including opportunity cost

examples.en: Economic cost includes the owner's unpaid hours, not just invoices.
examples.zh: 「经济成本」包括经营者无偿投入的工时，不只是账单。

examples.en: The lecture contrasted book cost with the true economic cost.
examples.zh: 讲座对比了账面成本与真实的「经济成本」。

words.enDefinition: contracts requiring payment for a minimum quantity whether taken or not

examples.en: Take or pay contracts guarantee the pipeline a minimum volume fee.
examples.zh: 「提取或支付合同」保障管道方获得最低量费收入。

examples.en: Under our take or pay contracts, unused cargo still costs full freight.
examples.zh: 按「照付不议合同」，未提取的货量仍需支付全额运费。

collocations: review the take or pay contracts
redline the take or pay contracts
execute the take or pay contracts

words.enDefinition: the cost incurred in factory production

examples.en: Factory cost covers raw materials, direct labour, and machine time.
examples.zh: 「制造成本」涵盖材料、直接人工和机时。

examples.en: Compare factory cost with landed cost before setting any retail price.
examples.zh: 定价前先比较「工厂成本」与到岸成本。

words.enDefinition: an order related to factory

examples.en: The factory order for the winter woolens releases on Monday.
examples.zh: 冬季毛纺品的「工厂订单」周一发放。

examples.en: Each factory order carries its own cutting list and dye lot.
examples.zh: 每张「工厂订单」都附有裁剪单和染批号。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in support transactions

examples.en: The support price for milk holds even in glut seasons.
examples.zh: 牛奶「支持价格」在过剩季节也保持不变。

examples.en: Farmers welcomed the support price after two weak harvests in a row.
examples.zh: 连续两季歉收后，农户欢迎这项「保护价」。

words.enDefinition: a marketplace where trading activity takes place

examples.en: The Saturday trading market fills every lane around the clock tower.
examples.zh: 周六的「贸易市场」挤满了钟楼周围的每条巷子。

examples.en: Futures on the trading market settled sharply lower overnight in London.
examples.zh: 「交易市场」的期货一夜之间大幅收低。

collocations: clear goods through the trading market

words.enDefinition: an agent authorised to act in trade or commercial matters

examples.en: Our trade procurator in Gdansk signs for goods we never see.
examples.zh: 我们在格但斯克的「商务代理」代签那些从未过目的货物。

examples.en: Customs letters go to the trade procurator, not the yard.
examples.zh: 海关函件寄给「商务代理人」，不寄货场。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for alternative

examples.en: Alternative costs measure what the depot gives up by parking the fleet.
examples.zh: 「替换成本」衡量货场因闲置车队而放弃的收益。

examples.en: Accountants listed alternative costs for each of the three sites.
examples.zh: 会计为三个选址分别列出了「备选成本」。

words.zhGloss: (计算制造费用率)以直接人工成本为基础
words.enDefinition: the foundation used to measure direct labor costs
acceptedZhAnswers: (计算制造费用率)以直接人工成本为基础

examples.en: Overhead is applied on a direct labor costs basis here.
examples.zh: 这里按「直接人工成本基础」分摊制造费用。

examples.en: Switching to a direct labor costs basis lifted the machine rates.
examples.zh: 改用「直接人工成本」基础后，机时费率上调。

collocations: prioritise the direct labor costs basis
standardise the direct labor costs basis
monitor the direct labor costs basis

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from transportation

examples.en: Transportation revenue from the winter timber runs covers the loan.
examples.zh: 冬季木材运输的「运输收入」足以覆盖贷款。

examples.en: The ferry's transportation revenue dips sharply every single January without fail.
examples.zh: 轮渡的「运输收入」每年一月都会骤降。

words.enDefinition: the relative prices of a country’s exports compared with its imports

examples.en: Cheaper machinery imports improved the country's terms of trade this year.
examples.zh: 机械进口价格下降改善了该国「贸易条件」。

examples.en: Terms of trade swung against the growers when wool fell.
examples.zh: 羊毛跌价后，「进出口比价」转而对种植者不利。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for exporter's sales

examples.en: The exporter's sales price already includes the cold chain fee.
examples.zh: 「出口商销售价格」已包含冷链费用。

examples.en: Customs compared the exporter's sales price with the domestic list.
examples.zh: 海关将「出口商售价」与国内价目表比对。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for export

examples.en: The export discount shrinks once orders top fifty crates a month.
examples.zh: 订单超过五十箱后，「出口折扣」随之缩小。

examples.en: They banked the export discount against the rise in freight.
examples.zh: 他们用「出口折扣」抵消了运费上涨。

words.enDefinition: corporate managers; the people at that management level

examples.en: Corporate management visits the yard twice a year, rarely more.
examples.zh: 「公司主管层」每年巡视货场两次，很少更多。

examples.en: Pay at corporate management level froze while depot wages rose.
examples.zh: 「公司管理层」薪酬冻结期间，货场工资上调了。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for commercial

examples.en: Commercial expense covers the trade fair fees and the buyer lunches.
examples.zh: 「商业费用」涵盖商展会费用和招待买家的午餐。

examples.en: Book the booth fee under commercial expense, not under travel.
examples.zh: 展位费记在「商业费用」项下，别记差旅。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with commercial credit

examples.en: The commercial credit company funds smaller shops the banks avoid.
examples.zh: 这家「商业信用公司」为银行回避的小店铺提供资金。

examples.en: A commercial credit company checked the buyer's whole payment history.
examples.zh: 一家「商业信用机构」核查了买方的付款记录。

words.enDefinition: a business communication or commercial notice

examples.en: Every commercial message on the depot radio names the sender.
examples.zh: 货场广播里的每条「商务函电」都注明发件方。

examples.en: A commercial message ordered the spring seed stock overnight by wire.
examples.zh: 一封「商务电报」连夜订下了春季种子存货。

words.enDefinition: middle managers; the people at that management level

examples.en: Middle management runs the depot day to day, not head office.
examples.zh: 「中层管理人员」负责货场日常运营，而非总部。

examples.en: Last winter, the cuts fell hardest on middle management jobs.
examples.zh: 去年冬天裁员对「中层管理」岗位冲击最大。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to collect on delivery

examples.en: Collect on delivery sales carry a small carrier surcharge each time.
examples.zh: 「交货付款销售」需加收少量承运附加费。

examples.en: The depot reconciles collect on delivery sales every Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 货场每周五核对「货到付款」销售。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for combination

examples.en: The combination budget merges the depot, ferry, and market spending.
examples.zh: 「合并预算」把货场、轮渡和市场的开支合并在一起。

examples.en: Councilors studied the combination budget carefully before the November vote.
examples.zh: 十一月表决前，议员们研读了「综合预算」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of indirect manufacturing

examples.en: Indirect manufacturing cost covers kiln heat, line cleaning, and small tools.
examples.zh: 「间接制造成本」涵盖窑炉热耗和产线清洁。

examples.en: Spread the indirect manufacturing cost across all five production lines.
examples.zh: 把「间接制造成本」分摊到全部五条产线。

words.enDefinition: a pricing approach that adds a markup to cost

examples.en: The co-op prices the seed at cost plus a fair margin.
examples.zh: 合作社给种子按「成本加成」定价，只取合理利润。

examples.en: Cost plus pricing suits contracts where the scope keeps shifting.
examples.zh: 范围不断变动的合同适合「成本加成」计价。

words.enDefinition: the foundation used to measure cost plus

examples.en: The tender was built on a cost plus basis from the start.
examples.zh: 这份标书从一开始就按「成本加成基础」编制。

examples.en: On a cost plus basis, auditors review every single receipt.
examples.zh: 按「成本加成」核算时，审计员会查每张收据。

words.enDefinition: costs of supervising labour or operations

examples.en: The cost of supervision doubled when the night shift opened.
examples.zh: 夜班开设后，「管理费」翻了一倍。

examples.en: Charge the full cost of supervision to the jetty job.
examples.zh: 把「监督费用」计入突堤工程。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred to market products or services

examples.en: The cost of marketing the hams includes the smoking house rent.
examples.zh: 火腿的「运销成本」包括熏房租金。

examples.en: Catalogue printing dominates the cost of marketing the winter wool.
examples.zh: 目录印刷占羊毛「营销成本」的大头。

words.enDefinition: direct costs incurred at the start of a transaction or project

examples.en: Initial direct cost for the lease covers the survey and legal fees.
examples.zh: 租约的「初始直接成本」包含勘察费和律师费。

examples.en: Capitalise the initial direct cost rather than expensing it at once.
examples.zh: 「初始直接成本」应予资本化，不能直接费用化。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit payable against clean documents (without full shipping-document sets)

examples.en: A clean letter of credit releases funds without shipping papers.
examples.zh: 「光票信用证」无需货运单据即可放款。

examples.en: They chose a clean letter of credit for the deposit stage.
examples.zh: 定金阶段他们选用了「光票信用证」。

collocations: arrange the clean letter of credit
monitor the clean letter of credit
repay the clean letter of credit

words.zhGloss: 分段制造费用成本计算法
words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for multistep overhead
acceptedZhAnswers: 分段制造费用成本计算法

examples.en: Multistep overhead costing allocates kiln heat before the machine hours.
examples.zh: 「分段制造费用成本计算法」先分摊窑炉热耗，再算机时。

examples.en: Under multistep overhead costing, service bays charge the lines first.
examples.zh: 按「多步间接费用分摊法」，服务工位先向产线收费。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for net operating

examples.en: Net operating costs fell after the second milking robot arrived.
examples.zh: 第二台挤奶机器人到位后，「运营成本净额」下降。

examples.en: The report lists net operating costs beside the gross takings.
examples.zh: 报告把「营业费用净额」与总收入并列。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to cost in

examples.en: Cost in business is more than receipts; it is foregone choices.
examples.zh: 「企业成本」不只是收据上的数字，还有放弃的选择。

examples.en: The chapter on cost in business uses the bakery's ledgers.
examples.zh: 「企业成本」一章引用了面包店的账册。

words.enDefinition: a marketplace where circulation activity takes place

examples.en: Cheap newspapers built a huge circulation market in the port towns.
examples.zh: 廉价报纸在港口城镇建立了庞大的「发行市场」。

examples.en: The circulation market for the gazette doubled after the ferry ads.
examples.zh: 轮渡广告上线后，这份公报的「发行市场」翻倍。

words.enDefinition: money received from contractual

examples.en: Contractual income from the mooring fees arrives on fixed dates.
examples.zh: 系泊费带来的「契约固定收入」按固定日期到账。

examples.en: Contractual income steadied the school's budget through the whole term.
examples.zh: 「合同收入」稳住了学校整个学期的预算。

words.zhGloss: 包括起货费用在内价格
words.enDefinition: the price charged in landed transactions
acceptedZhAnswers: 包括起货费用在内价格

examples.en: The landed price includes unloading, customs, and the cartage into town.
examples.zh: 「到岸价格」包含卸货、关税和进城运费。

examples.en: Compare the landed price against the quay quote before ordering.
examples.zh: 下单前，先比较「到货价」与码头报价。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage manual of budgetary

examples.en: The manual of budgetary control sits beside the treasurer's ledger.
examples.zh: 「预算控制手册」就放在司库的账册旁。

examples.en: New clerks sign for the manual of budgetary control on day one.
examples.zh: 新文员入职第一天就要签收「预算控制手册」。

collocations: govern the manual of budgetary control
escalate the manual of budgetary control
stabilise the manual of budgetary control

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for manufacturing costs

examples.en: The manufacturing costs budget assumes two kilns run through October.
examples.zh: 「制造成本预算」假定两座窑运行到十月底。

examples.en: Adjust the manufacturing costs budget when the wool price shifts.
examples.zh: 羊毛价格变动时要调整「制造成本预算」。

words.enDefinition: a business establishment engaged in manufacturing

examples.en: The manufacturing establishment on Cooper Lane employs forty full-time hands.
examples.zh: 库珀街的这间「制造企业」雇有四十名工人。

examples.en: Rate relief applies to any manufacturing establishment inside the walls.
examples.zh: 城墙内的任何「制造厂」都适用税率减免。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for manufacturing expense

examples.en: The manufacturing expense budget reserves coal for the January frost.
examples.zh: 「制造费用预算」为一月霜冻预留了燃煤。

examples.en: They trimmed the manufacturing expense budget after the gas contract.
examples.zh: 天然气合同签订后，他们压缩了「制造费用预算」。

words.enDefinition: a formal presentation of information about manufacturing

examples.en: The manufacturing statement reconciles raw wool with the finished blankets.
examples.zh: 「生产报表」把原毛与成品毛毯的数量勾稽起来。

examples.en: File the quarterly manufacturing statement with the customs office in person.
examples.zh: 把季度「生产报表」报送海关办公室。

words.enDefinition: operations involving manufacturing

examples.en: Manufacturing operations pause each August while the kiln is rebricked.
examples.zh: 每年八月重砌窑炉时，「生产作业」暂停。

examples.en: Dust from manufacturing operations settles on the drying sheds nearby.
examples.zh: 「制造作业」的粉尘落在晾棚上。

words.enDefinition: cash or collateral deposited as a margin requirement

examples.en: The broker asked for margin money before the wool futures opened.
examples.zh: 羊毛期货开盘前，经纪商要求先缴「保证金」。

examples.en: Margin money sits in a locked account until the contract closes.
examples.zh: 「预收保证金」存在专户中，直至合同了结。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for manufacturing overhead

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead budget adds five percent for winter kiln heat.
examples.zh: 「制造费用预算」为冬季窑炉取暖多列了百分之五。

examples.en: Compare actual kiln hours against the manufacturing overhead budget each month.
examples.zh: 每月将实际窑时与「制造费用预算」核对。

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual manufacturing overhead budget

examples.en: A favourable manufacturing overhead budget variance followed the new metering.
examples.zh: 新装计量表后，「制造费用预算差异」转为有利。

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead budget variance report goes to the works council.
examples.zh: 「制造费用预算差异」报告提交工厂委员会。

words.enDefinition: the cost of manufacturing overhead

examples.en: Manufacturing overhead cost per basket fell after the dye room moved.
examples.zh: 染房搬迁后，每只篮子的「制造费用成本」下降。

examples.en: Allocate the manufacturing overhead cost by machine hours, not headcount.
examples.zh: 「制造费用成本」按机时分摊，而非按人头。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for making up

examples.en: The making up price covers the hem stitching and buttons.
examples.zh: 「加工价格」涵盖缝边和钉扣的费用。

examples.en: Buyers questioned the making up price on the linen shirts.
examples.zh: 买家对亚麻衬衫的「加工费」提出疑问。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for commission

examples.en: The commission agent takes three percent on every wool sale.
examples.zh: 「佣金代理」按每笔羊毛交易抽取百分之三。

examples.en: Our commission agent in Bilbao handles the olive oil contracts.
examples.zh: 我们在毕尔巴鄂的「代理商」负责橄榄油合同。

words.enDefinition: an established way of doing business

examples.en: Card surcharges were banned as an unfair commercial practice last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，刷卡附加费因构成不公平「商业惯例」而被禁。

examples.en: Long credit periods are a common commercial practice at the fruit market.
examples.zh: 长账期是水果市场常见的「商业做法」。

words.enDefinition: a firm’s commercial reputation or credit standing

examples.en: The syndicate checked the bidder's commercial standing before the tender.
examples.zh: 辛迪加在招标前核查了投标人的「商业信誉」。

examples.en: Her commercial standing rests on twenty years of punctual delivery.
examples.zh: 她的「商业信誉」建立在二十年准时交货之上。

words.zhGloss: 费用总额预算的生产水准
words.enDefinition: the activity level assumed in the master budget
acceptedZhAnswers: 费用总额预算的生产水准

examples.en: The master-budgeted activity assumes ninety full cargo sailings each quarter.
examples.zh: 「总预算作业量」假设每季度满载航行九十次。

examples.en: Set the master-budgeted activity level before booking any crew overtime.
examples.zh: 预订船员加班前，先定好「总预算作业水平」。

words.enDefinition: a path through which goods move from producer to customer

examples.en: The village's marketing channel runs from orchard to ferry kiosk.
examples.zh: 村里的「销售渠道」从果园一直通到轮渡小卖部。

examples.en: Add a second marketing channel before the plum glut hits.
examples.zh: 李子上市高峰来临前，先增设一条「销售渠道」。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for marketing

examples.en: Marketing expenses for the new cheese brand doubled this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，奶酪品牌的「营销费用」翻倍。

examples.en: Split marketing expenses between the depot and the export arm.
examples.zh: 把「营销费用」在货场与出口部门之间分摊。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for marketing expense

examples.en: The marketing expense budget caps the ferry poster campaign at two hundred.
examples.zh: 「营销费用预算」给轮渡海报宣传设定两百上限。

examples.en: She defends the marketing expense budget at the January board meeting.
examples.zh: 她在一月董事会上为「营销费用预算」辩护。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing goods in lots of a defined size

examples.en: Lot production suits the glazes, which change colour by batch.
examples.zh: 「分批生产」适合按批次变色的釉料。

examples.en: Under lot production, each firing carries its own kiln card.
examples.zh: 采用「分批生产」时，每窑都配有自己的窑卡。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning company

examples.en: The company contract with the ferry company expires in March.
examples.zh: 与轮渡公司的「公司合同」三月到期。

examples.en: Sign the company contract before we move the grain silos.
examples.zh: 搬移粮仓之前，先签好「公司合同」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in competitive transactions

examples.en: The cooperative's competitive price held firm despite the fuel surge.
examples.zh: 尽管燃油涨价，合作社的「竞争性价格」保持不变。

examples.en: A competitive price won the cheese contract back from the importers.
examples.zh: 有「竞争力」的价格从进口商手中夺回了奶酪合同。

words.enDefinition: the full cost including all assigned elements

examples.en: The complete cost of the van includes plates and VAT.
examples.zh: 货车的「全部成本」包括牌照和增值税。

examples.en: Quote the complete cost, or the buyer will feel ambushed.
examples.zh: 报「全部成本」，否则买家会觉得被暗算。

words.enDefinition: a market in which prices are generally rising and investor confidence is high

examples.en: The bull market carried copper prices for two straight years.
examples.zh: 「牛市」让铜价连涨了两年。

examples.en: Veterans warn that every bull market hides some weak hands.
examples.zh: 老手警告说，「牛市」也会掩盖弱手。

collocations: clear goods through the bull market

words.enDefinition: a cartel that coordinates production among members

examples.en: The production cartel fixed kiln firing schedules across the region.
examples.zh: 「生产卡特尔」操纵了全区的窑炉排产计划。

examples.en: Regulators fined the production cartel heavily for holding back output.
examples.zh: 「生产卡特尔」因压产被监管机构罚款。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for production costs

examples.en: The production costs budget allows for one overtime weekend each month.
examples.zh: 「生产成本预算」每月留有一个加班周末的余量。

examples.en: She tracks the production costs budget beside the sales plan.
examples.zh: 她把「生产成本预算」与销售计划对照跟踪。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in procurement transactions

examples.en: The procurement price for school milk is set each June.
examples.zh: 学生奶的「采购价格」每年六月确定。

examples.en: Public bodies must publish the procurement price for every lot.
examples.zh: 公共机构必须公布每个标段的「采购价」。

words.enDefinition: a government office responsible for budget preparation and control

examples.en: The bureau of budget released the ferry grant in April.
examples.zh: 「预算局」四月拨付了轮渡补助。

examples.en: Forms from the bureau of budget changed again this autumn.
examples.zh: 今年秋天，「预算局」的表格又改版了。

words.enDefinition: a deposit placed by a customer with a seller or bank

examples.en: The customer's deposit stays in the escrow file until fitting.
examples.zh: 「客户定金」存于托管档案，直至安装完成。

examples.en: Refund the customer's deposit in full within seven days of cancelling.
examples.zh: 取消订单后七日内退还「客户押金」。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to budgeted

examples.en: Budgeted overhead assumes the gas boiler runs six hours daily.
examples.zh: 「预算间接费用」假定燃气锅炉每天运行六小时。

examples.en: Compare the actual kiln fuel against budgeted overhead every Monday.
examples.zh: 每周一将实际窑炉燃料与「预算制造费用」比对。

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting budgeted

examples.en: The budgeted balance sheet assumes the second cold store opens in May.
examples.zh: 「预计资产负债表」假定第二座冷库五月启用。

examples.en: Show me the budgeted balance sheet before the bank meeting.
examples.zh: 见银行之前，给我看「资产负债预算表」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of carrying out a project

examples.en: Project cost for the slipway repair climbed after the survey.
examples.zh: 勘测之后，滑道修缮的「项目成本」攀升。

examples.en: Track the project cost weekly against the council's grant letter.
examples.zh: 每周对照拨款函跟踪「项目成本」。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage project cost

examples.en: Project cost control here starts with a signed variation order.
examples.zh: 「项目成本管理」从签署变更单开始。

examples.en: Good project cost control saved the jetty job in December.
examples.zh: 严格的「项目成本管控」在十二月救了突堤工程。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for pre-contract

examples.en: Pre-contract costs like surveys are recoverable if the deal signs.
examples.zh: 若签约成功，勘察等「合同期前费用」可以收回。

examples.en: Log the pre-contract costs separately from the main works account.
examples.zh: 「合同前成本」要与工程账户分开记录。

words.enDefinition: a transaction in which businesses are brought under common control

examples.en: The business combination of the two ferries cut duplicated crews.
examples.zh: 两家轮渡公司的「企业合并」裁减了重复班组。

examples.en: Accountants dated the business combination from the first of July.
examples.zh: 会计师把「企业合并」的基准日定在七月一日。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning price

examples.en: The price contract locks flour rates until the spring harvest.
examples.zh: 「价格合约」把面粉价格锁定到春收。

examples.en: Renew the price contract before the August futures spike hits.
examples.zh: 在八月期货飙升前续签「价格合约」。

words.enDefinition: a firm’s reputation for creditworthiness in business

examples.en: Suppliers asked for references to confirm the bakery's business standing.
examples.zh: 供应商要求提供担保人，以证实面包店的「营业信用」。

examples.en: Her business standing earned an extra month of trade credit.
examples.zh: 她的「商业信誉」为她赢得了一个月的额外账期。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage budget

examples.en: Budget control tightened once the depot started weekly cash reviews.
examples.zh: 货场开始每周现金复盘后，「预算控制」收紧了。

examples.en: Budget control flagged the overtime spend before the quarter closed.
examples.zh: 「预算控制」在季度结束前标出了加班超支。

words.enDefinition: a system for budget control

examples.en: The budget control system blocks purchase orders above the limit.
examples.zh: 「预算控制系统」会拦截超限的采购单。

examples.en: Their budget control system sends alerts to the branch managers.
examples.zh: 他们的「预算控制系统」会向分店经理发送预警。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to budget

examples.en: Budget overhead for the depot includes the night watchman's wage.
examples.zh: 货场的「预算管理费用」包括夜间守卫。

examples.en: Budget overhead fell after the heating was moved to timers.
examples.zh: 供暖改用定时器后，「预算管理费用」下降。

words.enDefinition: a warehouse under customs control for dutiable goods

examples.en: Bonded storage at the customs warehouse defers the import duty.
examples.zh: 在「海关仓库」保税存储可以递延关税。

examples.en: Inspectors sealed the customs warehouse wing holding the pending cargo.
examples.zh: 检查员封存了「海关仓库」中存放待验货物的库区。

collocations: clear goods through the customs warehouse

words.enDefinition: production measured or planned by quantity of output

examples.en: Quantity production of the pails began once the mould hardened.
examples.zh: 模具硬化后，铁桶开始「批量生产」。

examples.en: Quantity production cut the unit price below the import quote.
examples.zh: 「大批量生产」把单价压到了进口报价之下。

words.enDefinition: the cost of quality control

examples.en: Quality control cost covers the salt spray chamber and lab hours.
examples.zh: 「质量管理成本」涵盖盐雾试验箱和化验工时。

examples.en: Skipping tests lowers the quality control cost but raises claims.
examples.zh: 省略检测虽降低「质检成本」，却招来更多索赔。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost-plus fixed fee

examples.en: The cost-plus fixed fee contract shields both sides from scope drift.
examples.zh: 「成本加固定费用合同」保护双方免受范围蔓延影响。

examples.en: Under the cost-plus fixed fee contract, audits check the hours weekly.
examples.zh: 按「成本加固定费用合同」，每周审计核查工时。

collocations: draft the cost-plus fixed fee contract
sign the cost-plus fixed fee contract
enforce the cost-plus fixed fee contract

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost-plus percentage fee

examples.en: A cost-plus percentage fee contract rewards bigger bills, critics note.
examples.zh: 批评者指出，「成本加定比费用合同」会让账单越大越好。

examples.en: The council switched from a cost-plus percentage fee contract to fixed fee.
examples.zh: 市政会把「成本加定比费用合同」改为固定费用合同。

collocations: draft the cost-plus percentage fee contract
sign the cost-plus percentage fee contract
enforce the cost-plus percentage fee contract

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for cost-plus

examples.en: The cost-plus price on the jetty repairs was published openly.
examples.zh: 突堤修缮的「成本加成价格」公开公示。

examples.en: Buyers accepted the cost-plus price once the receipts were filed.
examples.zh: 收据归档后，买方接受了「成本加成价格」。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)的分配根据(基础)
words.enDefinition: the foundation used to measure overhead distribution
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)的分配根据(基础)

examples.en: The overhead distribution basis switched from floor area to machine hours.
examples.zh: 「制造费用分配基础」从占地面积改为机时。

examples.en: Explain the chosen overhead distribution basis in the annual notes.
examples.zh: 年报附注中要说明所选的「间接费用分配基础」。

words.enDefinition: a cash deposit required of importers before or when importing

examples.en: The import deposit scheme required cash before any timber cleared.
examples.zh: 「进口押金」制度要求木材清关前先存入现金。

examples.en: They reclaimed the import deposit once the goods were re-exported.
examples.zh: 货物复出口后，他们收回了「进口押金」。

words.enDefinition: a scheme requiring importers to lodge a cash deposit

examples.en: The import deposit scheme returned the cash in full after re-export.
examples.zh: 「进口押金制」在复出口后退还现金。

examples.en: Importers grumbled that the import deposit scheme froze working capital.
examples.zh: 进口商抱怨「进口押金制度」冻结了流动资金。

words.enDefinition: cash collected from customers for sales or receivables

examples.en: Cash receipts from customers always peak before the holiday fair.
examples.zh: 节前集市前，「向顾客收现」达到高峰。

examples.en: Log all cash receipts from customers against each invoice number.
examples.zh: 「顾客现金收入」要逐笔对应发票号登记。

collocations: book the cash receipts from customers
forecast the cash receipts from customers
allocate the cash receipts from customers

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for cash selling

examples.en: The cash selling price undercuts the instalment plan by a tenth.
examples.zh: 「现售价格」比分期方案便宜一成。

examples.en: Ask for the cash selling price before signing any hire papers.
examples.zh: 签任何租购文件前，先问清「现金售价」。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)的分配表
words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting overhead distribution
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)的分配表

examples.en: The overhead distribution sheet splits kiln heat across four lines.
examples.zh: 「制造费用分配表」把窑炉热耗分摊到四条产线。

examples.en: File the overhead distribution sheet with the month-end reporting pack.
examples.zh: 把「间接费用分配表」归入月末资料包。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for cost production

examples.en: The cost production budget fixes wool at last season's price.
examples.zh: 「生产成本预算」按上季价格核定羊毛成本。

examples.en: Revisit the cost production budget once the dye contract renews.
examples.zh: 染料合同续签后，重新检视「生产成本预算」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in odd transactions

examples.en: The odd price of 9.99 tempts drivers at the pump.
examples.zh: 9.99 的「零头定价」让加油站的司机动心。

examples.en: Odd price tags dominate the souvenir stalls at the terminal.
examples.zh: 码头纪念品摊位上到处是「带零头的价格」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for operating

examples.en: The operating budget for the autumn assumes two extra sailings.
examples.zh: 秋季「营业预算」按加开两个航次编制。

examples.en: The councilors passed the operating budget with one dissenting voice.
examples.zh: 「运营预算」在一名议员反对下获得通过。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for operating

examples.en: Operating costs rose fastest on the winter night ferry crossings.
examples.zh: 冬季夜航的「营业费用」涨得最快。

examples.en: List operating costs beside ticket income in the annual report.
examples.zh: 年报中把「运营成本」与票款收入并列。

words.enDefinition: the cost of day-to-day operations

examples.en: Operational cost per passenger fell with the new booking system.
examples.zh: 新订票系统上线后，「经营成本」人均下降。

examples.en: Measure the operational cost monthly, not once a whole year.
examples.zh: 「经营成本」要按月测量，别一年才一次。

words.enDefinition: management of physical distribution

examples.en: Physical distribution management moved the pallets onto a single weekly barge.
examples.zh: 「实物配送管理」把托盘集中到每周一次的驳船上。

examples.en: Good physical distribution management cut the cold store dwell time.
examples.zh: 高效的「实物分配管理」缩短了冷库存留时间。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to credit in

examples.en: Credit in business between the mills goes back three generations.
examples.zh: 磨坊之间的「商业信用往来」已延续三代。

examples.en: She extended credit in business to the newly arrived stallholders.
examples.zh: 她向新摊主提供「赊账」往来。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in call transactions

examples.en: The call price on the bonds sits five percent above par.
examples.zh: 债券「赎回价格」定在面值上方百分之五。

examples.en: Investors watched the call price before buying the long notes.
examples.zh: 买长债之前，投资者盯着「赎回价」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of idle capacity

examples.en: Idle capacity cost from the empty second kiln hit nine thousand.
examples.zh: 二号窑闲置的「闲置产能成本」高达九千。

examples.en: Idle capacity cost counts even when the ovens never light.
examples.zh: 即使烤箱从未点火，「闲置产能成本」照样计入。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for general and administrative

examples.en: General and administrative expenses include the auditor and the office lease.
examples.zh: 「总务及管理费用」包括审计费和办公室租金。

examples.en: Trim the general and administrative expenses before touching crew wages.
examples.zh: 动船员工资前，先削减「总务管理费用」。

collocations: settle the general and administrative expenses
estimate the general and administrative expenses
approve the general and administrative expenses

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for forwarding

examples.en: The forwarding agent cleared the cheese through two border checkpoints.
examples.zh: 「货运代理」让奶酪顺利通过两道边境。

examples.en: Our forwarding agent books the fruit onto the night ferry.
examples.zh: 我们的「运输商」把水果订上夜班轮渡。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for working

examples.en: Working expenses on the branch line exceed the fares collected.
examples.zh: 支线的「运营费用」已超过票款收入。

examples.en: Trim the working expenses before cutting the last rural service.
examples.zh: 砍掉最后一条乡村线路之前，先压缩「营运费用」。

words.enDefinition: money received from earned

examples.en: Earned income from the stall keeps the family through winter.
examples.zh: 摊位的「经营收益」支撑一家人的过冬开销。

examples.en: The trust separates earned income from gifts and large legacies.
examples.zh: 信托把「劳动所得」与馈赠和遗赠分开核算。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage traffic

examples.en: Traffic control closes the bridge lane during the cattle fair.
examples.zh: 牛市期间，「交通管制」关闭桥上一条车道。

examples.en: Poor traffic control delayed the beet lorries by several hours.
examples.zh: 「交通指挥」不力让甜菜卡车延误了数小时。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to miscellaneous

examples.en: A miscellaneous receipt for the charity raffle totals forty-two pounds.
examples.zh: 抽奖所得的一张「杂项收入收据」共计四十二英镑。

examples.en: File each miscellaneous receipt with the treasurer by Monday noon.
examples.zh: 每张「零星收据」周一前交司库归档。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with income earning

examples.en: The trust holds income earning assets: moorings, meadows, and two cottages.
examples.zh: 信托持有「能生息的资产」：泊位、草场和两座小屋。

examples.en: Sell the derelict mill; it is no longer an income earning asset.
examples.zh: 卖掉废弃磨坊吧，它已不是「生息资产」。

words.enDefinition: a directory listing importers and exporters

examples.en: The chamber prints a directory of importers and exporters each March.
examples.zh: 商会每年三月印制「进出口商名录」。

examples.en: Her stall number appears in the directory of importers and exporters.
examples.zh: 她的摊位号已列入「进出口贸易商名录」。

words.enDefinition: an order document or instruction for cost of finished production

examples.en: The cost of finished production order feeds the monthly closing.
examples.zh: 「已完工生产订单成本」用于月末结账。

examples.en: Attach the cost of finished production order to the delivery note.
examples.zh: 交货单上要附「完工订单成本单」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of distribution and sales

examples.en: The cost of distribution and sales rose with the ferry fuel surcharge.
examples.zh: 轮渡燃油附加费推高了「分销和销售成本」。

examples.en: Split the cost of distribution and sales by sales region.
examples.zh: 把「分销与销售成本」按地区拆分。

collocations: classify cost of distribution and sales
measure cost of distribution and sales
disclose cost of distribution and sales

words.enDefinition: the cost of crude oil production

examples.en: The cost of crude oil production doubled in the north field.
examples.zh: 北油田的「原油生产成本」翻倍。

examples.en: Deep wells push the cost of crude oil production past sixty dollars.
examples.zh: 深井使「原油生产成本」突破六十美元。

words.enDefinition: costs of trucking and other transportation services

examples.en: The cost of trucking and transportation rides on diesel prices.
examples.zh: 「汽车运输成本」随柴油价格起落。

examples.en: Quote the cost of trucking and transportation before the beet season.
examples.zh: 甜菜季前先报「公路运输成本」。

words.enDefinition: contracts that reimburse costs and add an agreed fee

examples.en: Cost reimbursable and fee contracts suit the dredging works best.
examples.zh: 「成本补偿加费用合同」最适合疏浚工程。

examples.en: Under cost reimbursable and fee contracts, receipts are audited monthly.
examples.zh: 按「成本补偿加费用合同」，收据每月审计。

collocations: negotiate the cost reimbursable and fee contracts
renew the cost reimbursable and fee contracts
terminate the cost reimbursable and fee contracts

words.enDefinition: for each person; calculated on a per-person basis

examples.en: Butter consumption per capita doubled once the ferry landed daily.
examples.zh: 轮渡改为每日班次后，「人均」黄油消费翻倍。

examples.en: The subsidy works out at nine pounds per capita of the parish.
examples.zh: 补助折算下来，教区「人均」九英镑。

words.enDefinition: the social group between the upper and working classes

examples.en: The middle class of shopkeepers built the terraces behind the high street.
examples.zh: 「中产阶级」店主们在大街背后建起了联排住宅。

examples.en: Railway passes opened the coast to a growing middle class.
examples.zh: 铁路月票把海岸开放给了日益壮大的「中产阶层」。

words.enDefinition: an order related to mail

examples.en: Mail order brought the catalogue seed varieties to the island farms.
examples.zh: 「邮购」把目录里的种子送到岛上农场。

examples.en: The mail order desk answers customer letters every Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 「邮购」柜台每周二上午处理来信。

words.enDefinition: profit expressed as a percentage of sales or another base

examples.en: The profit margin on hampers beats the loose fruit trade.
examples.zh: 礼篮的「利润率」高于散装水果生意。

examples.en: Fuel prices swallowed the profit margin on the winter deliveries.
examples.zh: 燃油吞掉了冬季配送的「利润空间」。

words.enDefinition: a market for labour

examples.en: The harvest draws the local labour market to the orchards.
examples.zh: 收获季把本地「劳动力市场」引向果园。

examples.en: The labour market for sheep shearers tightens every single September.
examples.zh: 每年九月，剪毛工「劳动力市场」都会趋紧。

words.enDefinition: the cost of short-run marginal

examples.en: Short-run marginal cost of one more sailing is mostly fuel.
examples.zh: 多开一个航次的「短期边际成本」主要是燃油。

examples.en: Price the extra night crossing at its short-run marginal cost.
examples.zh: 加开的夜航按「短期边际成本」定价。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for sliding

examples.en: The sliding budget rolls forward every month at the depot.
examples.zh: 货场采用「滚动预算」，逐月向前滚动。

examples.en: Under a sliding budget, January's plan is revised each quarter.
examples.zh: 在「滑动预算」下，一月的计划每季度修订。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for shipping

examples.en: The shipping agent lodged the cargo manifest before the tide turned.
examples.zh: 「船运代理」赶在涨潮前递交了舱单。

examples.en: Our shipping agent in Hull arranges the pilot and the berth.
examples.zh: 我们在赫尔的「船运代理行」安排引航和泊位。

words.enDefinition: the cost of shipping and delivery

examples.en: Shipping and delivery cost is quoted separately on the invoice.
examples.zh: 发票上「运送成本」单独列示。

examples.en: Shipping and delivery cost fell once the routes were zoned.
examples.zh: 线路分区后，「运输与配送成本」下降。

collocations: estimate the shipping and delivery cost
allocate the shipping and delivery cost
cut the shipping and delivery cost

words.enDefinition: materials and supplies used in shipping goods

examples.en: Shipping supplies like dunnage and straps are issued from the cage.
examples.zh: 垫料、绑带等「装运用品」从料笼领用。

examples.en: Order the shipping supplies in bulk before the potato season opens.
examples.zh: 马铃薯季开始前先订购「发运耗材」。

words.enDefinition: an office handling shipping

examples.en: The shipping office stamps the coasting permits every working morning.
examples.zh: 「运输事务所」每天上午盖发沿海运输许可。

examples.en: Queue at the shipping office before the fishing fleet lands.
examples.zh: 渔船靠岸前，先去「航运办事处」排队。

collocations: clear goods through the shipping office

words.enDefinition: an order related to bad

examples.en: The mismatched tins were marked a bad order and returned.
examples.zh: 错配的罐头被标为「坏订单」退回。

examples.en: Bad orders cost the depot a full van run each month.
examples.zh: 「无法履行的订单」每月让货场白跑一车。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning bad

examples.en: Two seasons of bad trade emptied half of the arcade.
examples.zh: 两季「生意惨淡」让拱廊空了一半。

examples.en: Bad trade in hides dragged the tannery under at last.
examples.zh: 皮革「贸易不振」最终拖垮了制革厂。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit issued on the strength of another letter of credit, typically used by intermediaries

examples.en: The middleman opened a back-to-back letter of credit against the master.
examples.zh: 中间商凭主证开立了「背对背信用证」。

examples.en: Back-to-back letters of credit let agents trade without tying up their own capital.
examples.zh: 「背对背信用证」让代理商用不着自有资金也能做贸易。

collocations: arrange the back-to-back letter of credit
monitor the back-to-back letter of credit
repay the back-to-back letter of credit

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit issued on the strength of another letter of credit, typically used by intermediaries

examples.en: The back to back credit mirrors the master across two banks.
examples.zh: 「背对背信用证」跨两家银行对应主证开立。

examples.en: Traders request a back to back credit when the buyer insists on anonymity.
examples.zh: 买方要求匿名交易时，商人便申请「背对背信用证」。

collocations: arrange the back to back credit
monitor the back to back credit
repay the back to back credit

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from delivery

examples.en: Delivery revenue from the Saturday rounds funds the new crates.
examples.zh: 周六配送的「运输收入」为购置新货箱买单。

examples.en: Delivery revenue climbed once the depot charged by the drop.
examples.zh: 货场改为按单计费后，「配送收入」上升。

words.enDefinition: arbitration of foreign trade

examples.en: The wool dispute went to foreign trade arbitration in Vienna.
examples.zh: 羊毛纠纷提交维也纳进行「对外贸易仲裁」。

examples.en: Foreign trade arbitration spared both firms a two-year court battle.
examples.zh: 「外贸仲裁」让两家公司免于两年的法庭缠诉。

words.enDefinition: a commission or tribunal that settles disputes arising from foreign trade by arbitration

examples.en: The foreign trade arbitration commission heard the silk quality case.
examples.zh: 「对外贸易仲裁委员会」审理了丝绸质量案。

examples.en: File the claim with the foreign trade arbitration commission within sixty days.
examples.zh: 索赔须在六十天内提交「对外贸易仲裁委员会」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for delivery against

examples.en: The courier releases the parcel only on delivery against payment.
examples.zh: 快递员只在「付款交货」时才放件。

examples.en: Delivery against payment protects the seller when the buyer is new.
examples.zh: 买方是新客户时，「一手交钱一手交货」保护卖方。

words.enDefinition: the delivery and shipment of goods in a trade transaction

examples.en: Delivery and shipment terms appear on the reverse of the invoice.
examples.zh: 发票背面印有「交货与装运」条款。

examples.en: Delay the whole delivery and shipment until the strike ends.
examples.zh: 罢工结束前，暂缓「交货与装运」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in delivered transactions

examples.en: The delivered price includes cartage to any farm in the vale.
examples.zh: 「到货价」包含运抵谷内任何农场的运费。

examples.en: Always compare the delivered price, never the bare depot ticket.
examples.zh: 要比就比「到货价」，别只看货场的光杆标价。

words.enDefinition: delivery of goods from the seller’s warehouse

examples.en: Delivery ex-warehouse means the buyer arranges every mile after the gate.
examples.zh: 「仓库交货」意味着出库后的每一段运输都由买方安排。

examples.en: They quoted delivery ex-warehouse, so we hired our own cartage.
examples.zh: 对方报的是「仓库交货价」，我们只好自雇车队。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit facility that can be renewed or reused under agreed terms

examples.en: A standing credit with the wholesaler covers weekly flour orders.
examples.zh: 与批发商的「长期信用额度」覆盖每周面粉订单。

examples.en: Review the standing credit line before the Christmas stock build.
examples.zh: 圣诞备货之前，先复核「长期信用证额度」。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for standard overhead

examples.en: Standard overhead costs assume about forty kiln hours a month.
examples.zh: 「标准制造费用」按每月四十窑时核定。

examples.en: Track the standard overhead costs against the weekly meter readings.
examples.zh: 以电表读数对照「标准间接费用」。

examples.zh: 把「零售销售」与批发账并列跟踪。

words.enDefinition: an index of retail price

examples.en: The rent clause rises with the retail price index each October.
examples.zh: 租约条款每年十月随「零售价格指数」上调。

examples.en: Pensioners tracked the retail price index to argue for the raise.
examples.zh: 退休人员拿「零售物价指数」说理要求加薪。

words.enDefinition: a market for retail

examples.en: The Saturday retail market fills the whole square until four.
examples.zh: 周六「零售市场」一直热闹到四点。

examples.en: Wholesale buyers slip quietly into the retail market before dawn.
examples.zh: 批发商天亮前就溜进「零售市场」。

words.enDefinition: a group formed to submit a joint bid

examples.zh: 「投标小组」联合三家承运商参与突堤投标。

examples.zh: 保险报价翻倍后，我们的「竞标团」退出了。

words.enDefinition: an advertisement inviting bids

examples.zh: 「招标广告」在海港公报上登了两周。
