examples.zh: 委员会休会前拟好「招标启事」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting bid

examples.en: The bid sheet lists every carrier with its sealed figure.
examples.zh: 「投标人名单」逐家列明承运商与封标价。

examples.en: Sign the bid sheet before the clerk locks the box.
examples.zh: 书记员封箱之前，先在「投标单」上签字。

words.enDefinition: an invitation to submit a bid

examples.en: The bid invitation went out to six qualified dredging firms.
examples.zh: 「招标邀请」发给了六家疏浚公司。

examples.en: Read the bid invitation twice before pricing the mooring job.
examples.zh: 给系泊工程报价前，把「招标邀请」读两遍。

words.enDefinition: surety bonds guaranteeing that bidders will honour their bids if selected

examples.en: Bid bonds guarantee the dredgers will honour their tender prices.
examples.zh: 「投标保证金」担保疏浚商履行投标价。

examples.en: The bank issued bid bonds for the whole quay project.
examples.zh: 银行为码头项目出具了「投标保函」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of general

examples.en: General cost covers the heat, licences, and the office tea.
examples.zh: 「一般成本」涵盖取暖、牌照和办公室茶水。

examples.en: Split the general cost evenly across the four wet berths.
examples.zh: 把「一般成本」分摊到四个湿泊位。

words.enDefinition: a distributor covering a whole territory or market

examples.en: The general distributor covers every county west of the hills.
examples.zh: 这家「总经销商」的覆盖范围是山区以西各县。

examples.en: Only the general distributor may authorise regional repairs to the pumps.
examples.zh: 只有「总经销商」有权批准区域维修。

words.enDefinition: the cost of related

examples.en: Include every related cost before quoting the whole refit job.
examples.zh: 给整个翻新工程报价前，把每项「相关成本」都算进去。

examples.en: The related cost of the delay ran to ferry penalties.
examples.zh: 延误的「相关成本」包括轮渡罚金。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to going

examples.en: The receiver sold it as a going business, staff included.
examples.zh: 接管人把它作为「持续经营的企业」连人带店出售。

examples.en: A going business always fetches more than a shut workshop.
examples.zh: 「营业中的企业」比关门的作坊更卖得上价。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in relative transactions

examples.en: The relative price of coal against oil shifted twice this year.
examples.zh: 今年煤对油的「相对价格」变了两次。

examples.en: Farmers watch the relative price of wool against barley closely.
examples.zh: 农户盯着羊毛对大麦的「比价」。

words.zhGloss: 比照销售价值分配(成本)法

examples.zh: 「比照销售价值分配法」按市价分摊联产品成本。

examples.zh: 按「相对销售价值法」，奶油分摊的成本高于脱脂奶。

collocations: apply the relative sales value method
adopt the relative sales value method
document the relative sales value method

words.enDefinition: accounting for renewal expense

examples.en: Renewal expense accounting spreads the track renewal over ten years.
examples.zh: 「更新费用核算」把轨道更新费用分摊十年。

examples.en: Auditors questioned the renewal expense accounting for the kiln lining.
examples.zh: 审计员对窑炉内衬的「更新费用核算」提出疑问。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in remunerative transactions

examples.en: A remunerative price now finally covers the pickers' travel costs.
examples.zh: 「有利价格」终于能覆盖采摘工的路费。

examples.en: Growers held the crop back until a remunerative price appeared.
examples.zh: 种植户惜售，直到「合算的价格」出现。

words.enDefinition: the cost of renewal

examples.en: The renewal cost of the fleet lease doubles after August.
examples.zh: 车队租约的「更新成本」八月后翻倍。

examples.en: Factor the renewal cost into this year's subsidy request early.
examples.zh: 把「续新成本」计入今年的补助申请。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit facility that can be renewed or reused under agreed terms

examples.en: The renewable credit rolls over each quarter without fresh papers.
examples.zh: 「可展期信用证」每季度自动续期，无需重新办证。

examples.en: Exporters prefer a renewable credit for their steady seasonal orders.
examples.zh: 面对稳定的季节订单，出口商更喜欢「可续用的信用证」。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of renewal

examples.en: The agent draws a renewal commission on every annual policy.
examples.zh: 代理人每年从每份续保保单中抽取「续期佣金」。

examples.en: A steady renewal commission keeps the broker loyal to the insurer.
examples.zh: 「续保佣金」让经纪人始终忠于保险公司。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for regular

examples.en: The regular budget covers staff salaries, not the storm repairs.
examples.zh: 「经常预算」覆盖薪金，不含风暴修缮。

examples.en: The councilors guard the regular budget against any one-off raids.
examples.zh: 议员们守住「固定预算」，防止一次性挪用。

words.enDefinition: the cost of bona fide

examples.en: Only a bona fide cost with receipts qualifies for the grant.
examples.zh: 只有附收据的「真实成本」才符合补助条件。

examples.en: The tribunal accepted the haulage as a bona fide cost.
examples.zh: 仲裁庭认定这笔运费属于「真实支出」。

words.enDefinition: bond interest that has been paid

examples.en: The bond interest paid last year drained the whole sinking fund.
examples.zh: 去年「支付的公司债利息」掏空了偿债基金。

examples.en: The cash flow statement lists bond interest paid before dividends.
examples.zh: 现金流量表把「已付债券利息」列在股利之前。

words.enDefinition: to supervise or control how a market operates

examples.en: The board moved to regulate the market in seed potatoes.
examples.zh: 董事会着手「管理市场」上的种薯交易。

examples.en: No single buyer may be allowed to regulate the market alone.
examples.zh: 任何单一买家都不得独揽「市场管理」大权。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in regular transactions

examples.en: The regular price resumes as soon as the festival weekend ends.
examples.zh: 节庆周末一过，「正常价格」即恢复。

examples.en: Sale tags hang beside the regular price so buyers can compare.
examples.zh: 促销标牌挂在「原价」旁供人比较。

words.enDefinition: the cost of residual

examples.en: Residual cost of the demolition falls on the port trust.
examples.zh: 拆除的「残余成本」由港务信托承担。

examples.en: Residual cost of the old pipeline lingers in the accounts.
examples.zh: 旧管线的「剩余成本」仍挂在账上。

words.enDefinition: a reserve set aside for expected sales discounts

examples.en: The reserve for sales discounts smooths the seasonal rebate spike.
examples.zh: 「销售折扣准备」平滑了季节性返利的波动。

examples.en: The auditors test the reserve for sales discounts against its history.
examples.zh: 审计员按历史数据测试「销售折扣备抵」。

collocations: prioritise the reserve for sales discounts
standardise the reserve for sales discounts
monitor the reserve for sales discounts

words.enDefinition: the price charged in reserve transactions

examples.en: The reserve price for the trotters' mooring berth stays confidential.
examples.zh: 拖船泊位拍卖的「底价」保密。

examples.en: No lot sold below the reserve price at Tuesday's auction.
examples.zh: 周二拍卖会上，没有一件拍品低于「保留价」成交。

words.enDefinition: import quotas applied on a worldwide basis

examples.en: Global import quotas cap the annual banana landings very tightly.
examples.zh: 「全球进口配额」严格限制年度香蕉到港量。

examples.en: Global import quotas cap the annual banana landings very tightly.
examples.zh: 贸易商游说反对收紧的「全球进口配额」。

words.enDefinition: marketing of global

examples.en: Global marketing put the little cheddar cheese on Tokyo shelves.
examples.zh: 「全球营销」把小块切达奶酪送上了东京货架。

examples.en: Their global marketing budget dwarfs the entire creamery's annual turnover.
examples.zh: 他们的「全球营销」预算比整间奶油厂的营业额还大。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in blanket transactions

examples.en: The blanket price covers all the berths regardless of length.
examples.zh: 「统一价格」涵盖所有泊位，不论长短。

examples.en: The members challenged the blanket price at the spring meeting.
examples.zh: 春季会议上，会员对「一刀切价格」提出质疑。

words.enDefinition: an accepted requirement for reproduction-cost

examples.zh: 「再生产成本标准」按现行钢价厘定保额。

examples.en: Apply the reproduction-cost standard before you dispute the insurance claim.
examples.zh: 对理赔有异议前，先套用「重置成本标准」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of reproducing an asset as if new

examples.en: Reproduction cost new values the engine as if built today.
examples.zh: 「全新重置成本」把发动机按今日新造估价。

examples.en: Reproduction cost new excludes any discount for rust and age.
examples.zh: 「全新重置成本」不含任何锈蚀与老旧折减。

words.enDefinition: bidding limited to invited or selected bidders

examples.en: Selected bidding let the council invite only carefully vetted dredgers.
examples.zh: 「选择性招标」让市政会只邀请经过审查的疏浚商。

examples.en: Under selected bidding, only five firms received the tender pack.
examples.zh: 在「选择招标」下，五家公司收到了标书。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for free market

examples.en: The free market price for briquettes doubled within a month.
examples.zh: 煤饼的「自由市场价格」一个月内翻倍。

examples.en: Sell the surplus at the free market price, not the contract rate.
examples.zh: 余货按「自由市价」出售，不按合同价。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from selling

examples.en: Selling profit on the hampers funds the parish coach trips.
examples.zh: 礼篮的「销售利润」资助了教区班车。

examples.en: Selling profit shrank once the market stalls doubled their fees.
examples.zh: 摊位费翻倍后，「销售利润」缩水。

words.enDefinition: the cost of selling and administrative

examples.en: Selling and administrative cost consumed a third of the margin.
examples.zh: 「推销及管理成本」吃掉了三分之一的毛利。

examples.zh: 把「销售及管理成本」计入出口部门。

allocate the selling and administrative cost
cut the selling and administrative cost

examples.zh: 「卖方市场」让铁匠们自己开价。

examples.en: Few boats and many buyers made a seller's market for haddock.
examples.zh: 船少客多，黑线鳕成了「卖方市场」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for secondary market

examples.en: The secondary market price for the bonds slipped below par.
examples.zh: 债券「二级市场价格」跌破面值。

examples.en: Track the secondary market price before cashing in the debentures.
examples.zh: 变现信用债券前，先盯「二级市场价」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in settlement transactions

examples.zh: 「结算价格」在中午敲定当日谷物期货。

examples.zh: 合约按「结算价」了结，而非收盘前的口头价。

words.enDefinition: the cost of settling up

examples.en: Settling up cost for the partnership drained the last reserve.
examples.zh: 合伙清算的「清偿成本」耗尽了最后的储备。

examples.en: Ask the liquidator for a full settling up cost schedule.
examples.zh: 向清算人索要「清偿成本」明细表。

words.enDefinition: the cost of production setups

examples.en: Setup cost of the second dye run doubled the quote.
examples.zh: 第二次染整的「生产准备成本」让报价翻倍。

examples.en: Batch the small orders together to spread the setup cost.
examples.zh: 小订单并批生产，摊薄「换产成本」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which firms divide or share a market

examples.zh: 两家轮渡公司因「瓜分市场」被罚款。

examples.en: Sharing the market openly, the cartels fixed every quay fee.
examples.zh: 「共分市场」的卡特尔垄断了所有码头费。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to shareholders'

examples.zh: 「股东权益」吸纳了风暴损失，无需新增借款。

examples.en: The shareholders' equity dipped below the covenant line in March.
examples.zh: 三月，「股东权益」一度跌破契约红线。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of forwarding

examples.en: The forwarding commission covers the customs forms and quay handling.
examples.zh: 「发运代理佣金」涵盖报关单证和码头装卸。

examples.en: Add the forwarding commission before you compare the two quotes.
examples.zh: 比较两家报价前，先加上「发运佣金」。

words.enDefinition: arbitration of free

examples.en: The guild offered completely free arbitration for all member disputes.
examples.zh: 公会为会员纠纷提供「免费仲裁」。

examples.en: The guild offered completely free arbitration for all member disputes.
examples.zh: 「免费仲裁」在不用律师的情况下解决了系泊纠纷。

examples.zh: 「序列化流水线制造」让所有奶桶桶身完全一致。

examples.zh: 在「流水线序号化制造」下，每件产品都有铆钉编号。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from sale

examples.zh: 冬季出租的「销售收入」为春季备货提供资金。

examples.zh: 「销售收入」在买方提货当天入账。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for sales

examples.zh: 「销售折扣」只适用于四十箱以上的订单。

examples.en: Log every sales discount beside the customer account code carefully.
examples.zh: 每笔「销货折扣」都要记在客户编码旁。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning sales

examples.en: The sales contract fixes the delivery for the first frost.
examples.zh: 「销售合同」把交货期定在初霜。

examples.en: Both partners initialed every single page of the sales contract.
examples.zh: 两位合伙人在「销售合同」每页都签了缩写。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with sales

examples.en: The sales company in Hamburg handles all of the continental orders.
examples.zh: 汉堡的「销售公司」处理全部欧洲大陆订单。

examples.en: Their sales company shares a warehouse with the ferry agent.
examples.zh: 他们的「销售公司」与轮渡代理共用一座仓库。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for sales

examples.zh: 「销售代理」每周二拜访每家市场菜园。

examples.en: Our sales agent in Cork quotes the ferry rates directly.
examples.zh: 我们在科克的「销售代理」直接报轮渡运价。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for sales and administrative

examples.zh: 「销售和管理费」涵盖目录印制和办公室租金。

examples.en: Trim the sales and administrative expense before the spring catalogue.
examples.zh: 春季目录印制前，先压缩「销售及管理费用」。

collocations: settle the sales and administrative expense

approve the sales and administrative expense

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for sales

examples.zh: 火腿的「销售预算」按两场食品集市编制。

examples.en: Board members questioned the ferry assumptions inside the sales budget.
examples.zh: 董事们质询「销售预算」中的轮渡假设。

words.enDefinition: sales paid for in monthly installments

examples.zh: 「按月分期付款销售」让果农买得起榨汁机。

examples.en: The co-op offers sales on monthly installment to members only.
examples.zh: 合作社只对会员提供「按月分期销售」。

words.enDefinition: products related to sales of finished

examples.zh: 复活节前，「制成品销售」达到高峰。

examples.en: The ledger separates sales of finished goods from fuel resales.
examples.zh: 账册把「成品销售收入」与燃油转售分开。

words.enDefinition: persuasive talk used to promote a sale

examples.zh: 小贩的「推销话术」用两种语言许诺终身保修。

examples.en: Cut the sales talk short and show the safety record.
examples.zh: 少说「推销套话」，直接亮出安全记录。

words.enDefinition: management of sales

examples.zh: 「销售管理」每年一月重新划分市场配送路线。

examples.en: Good sales management pairs new sellers with the depot regulars.
examples.zh: 好的「销售管理」让新销售员与老客户结对。

words.enDefinition: money received from sales

examples.en: Sales income from the late plums kept the stall open.
examples.zh: 晚熟李子的「销售收入」让摊位撑了下去。

examples.en: Report the sales income net of the ferry ticket refunds.
examples.zh: 「销售收入」按扣除轮渡退款后的净额申报。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for deductible business

examples.zh: 「准予扣除的经营费用」包括摊位执照和货车燃油。

examples.en: Keep a receipt for all deductible business expenses this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度每笔「可扣税经营开支」都要留好收据。

examples.zh: 「预算削减」迫使货场只留一辆货车。

examples.zh: 预算再度「削减」，码头修缮随之推迟。

words.enDefinition: the cost of decremental

examples.zh: 停开周二班次的「减量成本」主要是燃油。

examples.zh: 取消第二个航次前，先比较「减量成本」。

words.zhGloss: 受益和成本之间的关系

examples.zh: 第二座过磅桥的「效益成本比」勉强为正。

examples.en: Slide rules aside, the benefit-to-cost relationship finally convinced the council.
examples.zh: 抛开计算尺，「收益成本关系」说服了市政会。

words.enDefinition: the cost of scheduled

examples.zh: 窑炉重建的「计划成本」列在十月计划中。

examples.en: Match the actual spend against the scheduled cost line weekly.
examples.zh: 每周把实际支出与「计划成本」一栏对照。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning deferred payment

examples.zh: 「延期付款贸易」帮年轻进口商熬过了霜冻。

examples.en: The banks hedge deferred payment trade against the currency swings.
examples.zh: 银行为「延期付款贸易」对冲汇率波动。

words.enDefinition: a sale of deferred payment

examples.zh: 「延期付款销售」让佃农先牵两只母羊回家。

examples.en: Under a deferred payment sale, title passes on the final instalment.
examples.zh: 「分期付款销售」下，产权在最后一期付清时转移。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing goods in batches rather than continuously

examples.zh: 「分批生产」适合随窑炉变化而变色的釉料。

examples.en: Under batch production, each firing gets its own kiln card.
examples.zh: 「成批生产」时，每窑都有自己的窑卡。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to schedule of manufacturing

examples.en: The schedule of manufacturing overhead lists kiln fuel by month.
examples.zh: 「制造费用明细表」按月列示窑炉燃料。

examples.en: File the schedule of manufacturing overhead with the year-end papers.
examples.zh: 把「制造费用明细表」归入年末资料。

collocations: prioritise the schedule of manufacturing overhead
standardise the schedule of manufacturing overhead
monitor the schedule of manufacturing overhead

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for full

examples.en: Under full costing, even the night watch lands on each crate.
examples.zh: 按「全部成本法」，连守夜费用也要摊进每只货箱。

examples.en: Full costing makes the artisan line look dearer than it sells.
examples.zh: 「全部成本法」让手工线看起来比实际售价更贵。

words.enDefinition: the cost of full

examples.en: The full cost of a delivery includes the return leg.
examples.zh: 一趟配送的「完全成本」包括回程。

examples.en: Quote the full cost, or the buyer will feel ambushed later.
examples.zh: 报「全部成本」，否则买家日后会觉得被暗算。
